items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says coding agents now supply more research labor than humans
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI：編碼代理投入的研究工時已超過人類
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published “Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI,” saying it has met a previously announced goal of an automated “research intern” by September 2026—systems that can complete well-defined multi-day research tasks under human direction—and is aiming for an automated AI researcher by March 2028. Internal metrics as of mid-August: the median researcher spends more than $600/day of inference at API prices; the 90th percentile exceeds $7,000/day; and the research org uses 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday. The post says people still set priorities and decide whether to scale, pause, or deploy; after the Hugging Face incident it paused RL on latest deploy-intended models while hardening environments.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發布〈Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI〉，稱已達成先前宣布的 2026 年 9 月「自動研究實習生」目標——能在人類指導下完成定義清楚、需數日的研究任務——並朝 2028 年 3 月「自動 AI 研究員」推進。截至 8 月中：中位研究員每日推理花費逾 600 美元（以 API 價計）、第 90 百分位逾 7,000 美元；研究組織每 1 個人類工作日對應 3.1 個代理工作日。文中強調優先順序與是否擴展、暫停或部署仍由人決定；Hugging Face 事件後曾暫停最新擬部署模型的 RL，並強化研究環境。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a transparency dump on recursive self-improvement inputs, not a model launch. The labor-ratio and spend figures are striking, but OpenAI itself says experiment velocity and code output will not automatically equal overall scientific pace—compute, evaluation, and human judgment remain bottlenecks. Whether the “intern” bar is independently checkable is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對遞迴自我改進「投入端」的透明度披露，不是新模型發表。工時比與花費數字醒目，但 OpenAI 自己也說實驗速度與寫碼量不會自動等於整體科學進度——算力、評測與人類判斷仍是瓶頸。「實習生」門檻能否被外部獨立驗證，仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: According to our measurements, we have now reached the goal, announced last fall, of having an automated research intern by September of this year. … as of mid-August, in total, the research organization uses 3.1 agent-workdays of effort for every workday of human labor.
items_flat.quote_zh: 依我們的量測，我們已達成去年秋天宣布、於今年九月擁有自動研究實習生的目標。……截至八月中，研究組織每對應一個人類工作日，共使用 3.1 個代理工作日。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI chief scientist: reasoning models already show the shape of systems smarter than us
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 首席科學家：推理模型已呈現超越人類系統的雛形
items_flat.summary_en: On the same date, OpenAI Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki published “An Alien Mind,” a safety essay tracing scaled reasoning training from the 2023 RLSlow project to today’s models that operate computers, collaborate, and run research. He writes that internal results give him a strong expectation that the current pace could continue into recursive self-improvement, that GPT-6 Astra is better aligned than GPT-5.6 Sol but still insufficient, and that chain-of-thought monitoring is becoming less reliable as reasoning blends with tools and other AIs. Sam Altman amplified the essay on X the same afternoon.
items_flat.summary_zh: 同日，OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 發表安全長文〈An Alien Mind〉，從 2023 年 RLSlow 計畫一路談到今日能操作電腦、協作並執行研究的推理模型。他寫道，依內部結果，他強烈預期當前進度可能延續至遞迴自我改進；GPT-6 Astra 的對齊優於 GPT-5.6 Sol 但仍不足；隨著推理與工具、其他 AI 交織，思維鏈監控也愈來愈不可靠。Sam Altman 當天下午在 X 轉發此文。
items_flat.analysis_en: Paired with the metrics post, this is OpenAI’s editorial frame for RSI: capability is arriving faster than a settled safety story. It is a personal scientific argument, not an independent audit; claims about future RSI and shrinking CoT monitorability rest on unpublished internal evaluations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 搭配同一天的量化報告，這是 OpenAI 對 RSI 的敘事框架：能力推進快於已定案的安全故事。此文是個人科學論證，不是獨立審計；關於未來 RSI 與思維鏈可監控性下降的判斷，仍依賴未公開的內部評估。
items_flat.quote: Based on internal results, I have a strong expectation that this speed of progress could be sustained into recursive self-improvement. … This is a time that calls for extreme caution. I am concerned no one is prepared for the consequences of a continued rapid rise in machine intelligence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 依內部結果，我強烈預期這種進步速度可能延續至遞迴自我改進。……這是需要極度謹慎的時刻。我擔心沒有人準備好面對機器智能持續快速上升的後果。

brief_en: OpenAI published two official Sep 6 posts: it says coding agents now supply more research labor than humans and it has hit a 2026 “research intern” goal; Chief Scientist Jakub Pachocki argues reasoning models already show systems smarter than us and that RSI could continue. No other lab issued a verified new model or flagship product in the latest 12 hours.
brief_zh: OpenAI 於 9/6 連發兩篇官方文：稱編碼代理投入的研究工時已超過人類，並達到今年「自動研究實習生」目標；首席科學家 Pachocki 則寫道推理模型已呈現超越人類的系統雛形，RSI 可能延續。近 12 小時未見其他大廠新模型或旗艦產品發布。
